MasulloGRH.Round12A.norm_twist_polar_divisor (τ : ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
  meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (z + ↑τ * Complex.I) * (z - (1 - ↑τ * Complex.I))) x =
    (if x = -↑τ * Complex.I then 1 else 0) + if x = 1 - ↑τ * Complex.I then 1 else 0

MasulloGRH.Round12A.uncleared_norm_twist_order (Z : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (hZ : MeromorphicAt Z x) :

MasulloGRH.Round12A.norm_twist_simple_poles (Z : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) (hZ0 : AnalyticAt ℂ Z (-↑τ * Complex.I))
  (hZ1 : AnalyticAt ℂ Z (1 - ↑τ * Complex.I)) (hne0 : Z (-↑τ * Complex.I) ≠ 0) (hne1 : Z (1 - ↑τ * Complex.I) ≠ 0) :
